title: Accelerating Outreach and Training at the Pacific Northwest CryoEM Center Through Advanced Sample Preparation with the Vitrojet
content: At the Pacific Northwest Cryo-Electron Microscopy Center (PNCC), our mission is to provide access to state-of-the-art instrumentation and expertise to empower researchers seeking to use cryo-EM in their work [1]. Cryo-EM is a rapidly evolving field in terms of hardware and software, so national facilities must take steps to ensure that they continue to provide access to cutting-edge technologies. This is especially impactful for researchers at institutions with little to no access to these tools, as is often the case for those in IDeA states and undergraduate-focused universities.
